messages:
emily: heads up — we’re seeing a spike of 429s for a subset of new API keys created in the last 20m. Dashboard shows per-key burst=0 for those keys
raj: seeing same, filtered by org: alpha-corp. Older keys fine.
dan: any recent console changes? I didn’t touch rate limiting code today.
sasha: console deploy 14:03 included the quota inheritance migration that backfills missing per-key burst values from org defaults.
emily: timeline matches — keys created during migration window look like they got a default of 0 instead of inheriting the org burst.
raj: logs from quota-service show translation error when encountering keys with null_burst -> it wrote 0. snippet: `if (burst == null) burst = 0;`
ops-bot: alert: 429 rate limit increase for prod region us-west-2 — 1200 events in 5m.
deploy-bot: deploy 0.14.7 to console finished at 14:02:58 by sasha.
dan: can we hotfix by toggling fallback to legacy-quota-read?
sasha: I pushed a change to the canary at 14:25 to add special-case for null -> inheritFromOrg(). Canaries look ok, but global rollouts already completed.
emily: mitigation attempt: temporarily enable routing rule to bypass quota-translation for requests with key.created_at >= 14:00 and <= 14:20? risky but precise.
raj: we should also consider a DB patch to set burst = org_default for affected keys. I can draft a safe update set.
lena: agree on DB patch + brief routing bypass. DB patch must be idempotent and only for keys with burst=0 and created_in_window.
ops-bot: NOTE: bulk DB writes must run on read-replica? we need to coordinate with infra.
dan: logs show about 1.1k keys impacted across 3 orgs. patch size manageable.
sasha: starting controlled rollback of console migration to prevent further new keys getting 0. doing rollback now.
emily: rolling routing bypass in 2 mins: add rule route->legacy-quota for keys with burst==0.
deploy-bot: feature flag update pushed to routing at 14:33:12.
raj: running DB patch dry-run now: `UPDATE api_keys SET burst = orgs.default_burst FROM orgs WHERE api_keys.burst = 0 AND api_keys.created_at BETWEEN '2025-03-01T14:00:00Z' AND '2025-03-01T14:20:00Z' RETURNING id;`
raj: dry-run returned 1123 rows. no surprises.
lena: schedule patch during low-traffic window? but impact ongoing. recommend run with small batching and monitoring.
dan: approve. run with 100 tx batch and pause on any errors.
sasha: rollback complete. no new keys should be affected.
emily: DB patch starting 14:40. Will monitor 429s and token-level dashboards.
ops-bot: bulk-patch job started: job_id=patch-1956789-01
raj: patch run 1/12: success. patch run 6/12: minor timeout on replica, retried, ok.
raj: final patch run complete. patched 1123 keys. verified audit sample: 20 keys show burst now equal to org default.
emily: 429s dropped back to baseline for alpha-corp. monitoring for other orgs.
sasha: I'll open a PR to change migration code path to explicit inherit() and add unit + integration tests.
dan: we should add a preflight simulation for migrations that touch rate-limits in console before rollout.
lena: add console-level safety: block any migration that leaves burst null; enforce non-null constraint in schema.
emily: will start incident postmortem doc and include rollback timeline + DB patch steps. action items: rollback gating, migration test harness, non-null DB constraint, routing fallback alert.
ops-bot: incident resolved at 14:58:00.
sasha: thanks everyone. please add any follow-ups to the postmortem thread. :tada:
